anomalies.description: A dark sedan enters the intersection from the right and collides with a white van/truck that is turning left; the impact causes the van to rotate sharply and the sedan to be pushed sideways.
A dark SUV collides with the side of a white semi-truck at an intersection, causing visible impact and immediate smoke emission from the truck's cab area.
A sudden burst of dark smoke and debris erupts from the cab of the semi-truck immediately after impact, consistent with a small explosion or rapid fire ignition (e.g., fuel line rupture).

A dark-colored SUV collides with the rear-left side of a white bus at an intersection, causing visible impact and dust/debris; the bus is already emitting black smoke from its roof before impact.; After initial impact, the SUV remains in contact or very close to the bus’s left rear as both vehicles move slowly through the intersection; secondary debris/dust is visible, indicating ongoing interaction or post-collision movement.

A multi-vehicle collision occurs at an intersection: a motorcycle is struck by a car (visible at f4), resulting in the motorcycle and rider being thrown across the road; debris scatters, and a second rider appears on the ground shortly after (f6–f10). A silver sedan also appears involved or affected (f12–f15).

A multi-vehicle collision involving a motorcycle, a silver sedan, and possibly other vehicles; the motorcycle is down in the road with debris scattered, and a person is on the ground near the left lane edge. The scene remains static across frames, indicating the immediate aftermath of the crash.
Two individuals engage in physical combat near a motorcycle at the intersection; one appears to strike or grapple the other, who then stumbles backward across the crosswalk.

A large dump truck collides with a white sedan at the intersection; the sedan is struck on its right side and pushed sideways as the truck continues forward.; A dump truck loses control while turning at an intersection, tips over onto its side, and spills its entire load of sand/soil across the road, directly impacting a white sedan that is crossing the intersection.
The white sedan is struck by the tipping dump truck and the cascading load of sand; it is pushed sideways and comes to rest heavily damaged near the curb, partially buried in the spilled material.
A white car collides with a person riding a small motorized scooter at an intersection; the impact throws the rider to the ground and the scooter falls beside them.
A white sedan collides with a yellow bus on a multi-lane highway, causing the sedan to be pushed sideways and then flip onto its roof after impact.
A white sedan collides with a yellow bus on a multi-lane highway, causing the sedan to flip onto its roof and a second white car to be struck; dust and debris are visible at impact.
A person in dark clothing approaches a stopped white SUV, opens the driver’s door, pulls the occupant out, and appears to strike or grapple with them on the road surface.
A person in dark clothing is seen climbing onto the hood of a moving white sedan, then being pushed or falling off as the vehicle continues forward; the individual appears helpless during contact.
A white bus with red and blue markings loses control at an intersection, swerves sharply, and collides with another vehicle (partially visible), resulting in visible deformation and skidding.

A sudden burst of dark smoke and debris erupts from the cab of the semi-truck immediately after impact, consistent with a small explosion or rapid fire ignition (e.g., fuel line rupture).

A dark-colored SUV collides with the rear-left side of a white bus at an intersection, causing visible impact and dust/debris; the bus is already emitting black smoke from its roof before impact.; After initial impact, the SUV remains in contact or very close to the bus’s left rear as both vehicles move slowly through the intersection; secondary debris/dust is visible, indicating ongoing interaction or post-collision movement.

A multi-vehicle collision occurs at an intersection: a motorcycle is struck by a car (visible at f4), resulting in the motorcycle and rider being thrown across the road; debris scatters, and a second rider appears on the ground shortly after (f6–f10). A silver sedan also appears involved or affected (f12–f15).

A multi-vehicle collision involving a motorcycle, a silver sedan, and possibly other vehicles; the motorcycle is down in the road with debris scattered, and a person is on the ground near the left lane edge. The scene remains static across frames, indicating the immediate aftermath of the crash.
Two individuals engage in physical combat near a motorcycle at the intersection; one appears to strike or grapple the other, who then stumbles backward across the crosswalk.

A large dump truck collides with a white sedan at the intersection; the sedan is struck on its right side and pushed sideways as the truck continues forward.; A dump truck loses control while turning at an intersection, tips over onto its side, and spills its entire load of sand/soil across the road, directly impacting a white sedan that is crossing the intersection.
The white sedan is struck by the tipping dump truck and the cascading load of sand; it is pushed sideways and comes to rest heavily damaged near the curb, partially buried in the spilled material.
A white car collides with a person riding a small motorized scooter at an intersection; the impact throws the rider to the ground and the scooter falls beside them.
A white sedan collides with a yellow bus on a multi-lane highway, causing the sedan to be pushed sideways and then flip onto its roof after impact.
A white sedan collides with a yellow bus on a multi-lane highway, causing the sedan to flip onto its roof and a second white car to be struck; dust and debris are visible at impact.
A person in dark clothing approaches a stopped white SUV, opens the driver’s door, pulls the occupant out, and appears to strike or grapple with them on the road surface.
A person in dark clothing is seen climbing onto the hood of a moving white sedan, then being pushed or falling off as the vehicle continues forward; the individual appears helpless during contact.
A white bus with red and blue markings loses control at an intersection, swerves sharply, and collides with another vehicle (partially visible), resulting in visible deformation and skidding.
